function: Active user detection (Transformer) plus joint channel estimation and data detection (diffusion-model sampling with learned channel prior) in massive MIMO random access (p. 3, p. 6-7).
system: Uplink narrowband random access: BS with 8x8 UPA (64 antennas), K=128 single-antenna users, 10% active, 4QAM, 3.5 GHz; no RIS (p. 3, p. 11).
method: Heterogeneous Transformer with pilot-length adaptive module, supervised BCE for AUD; NCSN++ score network, unsupervised denoising score matching, as channel prior in predictor-corrector sampler (p. 5-10).
data_channel: 3GPP 38.901 UMa NLOS channels at 3.5 GHz from QuaDRiGa: 64,000 samples for AUD net, 160,000 for score net; i.i.d. Rayleigh also (p. 11).
test_conditions: AUD net trained at M=64, pilot lengths 8-24 or 10-28, activity 0.1; tested at M=144, activity 0.06-0.2, varied pilot lengths; JCEDD varies SNR, Lp, Ld (p. 11-14).
baselines: AUD: AMP, OMP, fixed-pilot-length VPL-AUDNet. CE/DD: LS, LMMSE+OAMP, ZF, iterative Langevin CE&DD [33] (learned score), perfect-CSI/data references (p. 11).
metrics: AEP, Pfa-Pmd for AUD; NMSE for CE; BER for DD; computation latency and complexity orders (p. 11-15).
complexity: Table I gives orders, e.g. O(L^2M+Ka^2M) channel likelihood score, O(Ka*Fnet) prior score; latency 1.44-2.62 s in Tables II-III (p. 10, p. 15).
q1_support: p. 11: "3GPP-compliant channel model [39] generated using Quadriga [49], simulating the 3GPP 38.901 UMa NLOS scenario"
q2_support: p. 12: "testing the model trained with M = 64 antennas on the channels with M = 144 antennas"
q3_support: p. 11: "Pilot LS-CE & ZF-DD" (non-learned) and "Iter Langevin CE & DD: Conduct iterative CE and DD using ALD [33]" (earlier diffusion-based scheme); both compared in NMSE and BER, Fig. 10, p. 13
q4_support: p. 10: "The complexity analysis of Algorithm 2 is detailed in Tab. I"; latency of the method in Tables II and III, p. 15
q5_support: p. 11: "A total of 64,000 channel samples are generated using Quadriga"; the data are self-generated and no code or data link is given.
notes: Included for the JCEDD stage; the Transformer AUD is outside the seven areas. Area 2 because the only learned part of JCEDD is the channel prior score network; DD (area 1) is the alternative. q3 learned baseline [33] shares the Langevin diffusion idea but is an earlier published scheme. q2 rests on the AUD net tested at M=144.
